title: Fix argument release race in the AOF duration test module
body:
`run_steps_bg_worker()` releases held command arguments after unlocking the module GIL and unblocking the client. This races with the main thread reading those arguments while recording slowlog entries

Related PR: https://github.com/redis/redis/pull/15665
Failed daily CI on 2026-09-16: https://github.com/redis/redis/actions/runs/35038994310/job/104614406538

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Test-only module change; no production Redis or module API behavior is modified beyond fixing a race in test infrastructure.
> 
> **Overview**
> Fixes a **thread-safety race** in the AOF duration test module’s `run_steps_bg_worker` background thread.
> 
> Held command arguments (`RedisModule_HoldString` copies) are now freed **while the thread-safe context lock is still held**, immediately after `aofd_rm_run_steps` and **before** `RedisModule_ThreadSafeContextUnlock` and `RedisModule_UnblockClient`. Previously those strings were freed only after unblock, so the main thread could still read them (e.g. for slowlog) while the worker freed them—matching the failure seen in sanitizer CI on `unit/moduleapi/aofduration`.
